content: Delete all the closed claims that are more than two years old.

I can't delete records from here. I can only read data and prepare tasks, file notes and claim or service request status changes for you to confirm.

If it helps, I can pull a list of closed claims reported more than two years ago. You or a Salesforce admin could then review it and handle the deletion or archiving, which may also need to follow Antsurance's record retention rules.
